name: Mordax DATA
source: Mordax DATA - User Guide - 171002.pdf p4 (DATA Overview), p27; ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026)
notes: Jack count and directions confirmed from the overview diagram: 4 inputs (top-left row), 4 buffered through jacks (row below, each a buffered copy of its input), 4 outputs (2x2 on the right). The diagram shows no printed labels, so names follow the manual's wording (INPUT1-4, Through Jacks, OUT1-OUT4). What each input/output does depends on the running program (e.g. Clock: IN 1 ext clk/run-stop, IN 2 reset, IN 3-4 CV, OUT 1-4 clocks).
